messages:
tara: quick sync — trying to land where the interrupt controls and compact counter live in the chat pane. thinking about accessibility and not making the controls jump while streaming. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx (v1.2) kevin: +1 — main concerns: discoverability for Stop vs Pause, and keyboard focus order. we don't want the counter to steal focus on every token update. maria: agree. for voiceover the counter should be `aria-hidden` by default and only announced on request (e.g., via a verbose state). otherwise it's noise. jon: can we also avoid layout shift when regen shows up? current mock inserts regen button and pushes everything left. maybe overlay it? sam: overlay sounds good. small sketch:```jsx
512
``` kevin: nit: if regen is absolute we need to reserve ~48px hit area on small screens or it overlaps the message actions. also ensure the stop button is first in tab order: `tabindex=0` then counter (hidden from focus) then regen. tara: thanks. accessibility checklist so far: 1) stop button distinct color + visible focus ring, 2) counter `aria-hidden` by default, 3) regen uses `aria-pressed`/role toggle when available, 4) overlay approach to avoid CLS, 5) mobile hit area >=44px. anyone want to add copy tweaks? maria: microcopy — instead of "Stop" use "Stop generation" for screen readers and keep visual label short. For regen tooltip use: "Regenerate response (keeps history)". designbot: mock updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx?node-id=42:7 — added a compact variant for narrow widths and an optional persistent counter in settings. deploy note: will gate compact variant behind `feature.playgroundCompactControls` on staging.
